owner_decision.rationale: The staging project's plan does not sell HaveIBeenPwned leaked-password checking, and K Scan is not changing Supabase plans solely to satisfy a certification check. The capability gap is a property of the environment's subscription, not of any release candidate: no candidate change can clear it, so blocking staging certification on it measures the billing plan rather than the release.

entitlement_evidence.mechanism: Targeted Supabase Management API PATCH of password_hibp_enabled against the staging project only.
entitlement_evidence.note: HTTP 402 Payment Required is the only observation accepted as proof of a plan/entitlement limit. A 401/403, a timeout, an unreachable API, or any other status classifies as UNKNOWN and blocks. If the plan ever changes, the same probe enables the setting and certification returns to PASS without further edits.

owner_action: None for staging. Production promotion still requires the control: enabling it there needs a plan that provides HaveIBeenPwned leaked-password checking.
notes: This control is recorded as ABSENT, never as satisfied. Certification reports NOT_APPLICABLE_PLAN_LIMIT rather than PASS or ENABLED so no reader can conclude that leaked-password protection exists on staging. The waiver is scoped to this one control in security/scripts/build-staging-certification.js (PLAN_LIMIT_ELIGIBLE) and cannot spread to any other gate.
